title: [3.0-beta1] "AndroidAPS Started" message sent to NS despite disabling "log app start to ns" in settings
body:
Using 3.0-beta1 with Dash pod, AndroidAPS on my daughters Huawei, NSClient on my Samsung
Have disabled "log app start to NS" in preferences on both phones. Despite this, the message pops up on both phones and in Nightscout after app restart. This goes both ways no matter which app is restarted, the message shows in NS and on other phone. 
Have tried enabling and disabling the setting, but still happens afterwards.
